How it works

  1. 1

    Imagine it

    Ask for anything: a ranch with sheep, a base on the moon, a spooky town for trick or treat.

  2. 2

    Watch it come alive

    Buildings, animals and people appear, and the world runs on its own: day and night, rain and sun, the seasons.

  3. 3

    Play in it

    Talk to it, change it, add to it, and see what happens next.

It's everything

A ranch is just the start. If you can imagine it, it can be a place in Abbie's World.

Always PG

Abbie's World is made for kids. Everything you build here stays PG, and the Computer that helps you build only helps with the game. A grown-up signs in, and it's free. We don't keep anything about you except that you signed in.

Support Abbie's World

Playing is free, and so is a little AI magic. Support Abbie's World each month and almost all of it comes back to you as AI magic that month: talking to the Computer and having it build for you. A little helps pay for the servers and for Evan's time. You can cancel any time.
